purpose: Test global optimality and objective sensitivity of the NT$1,000-grid equal-risk structural comparator without using outcomes.

postShare: min plan-preview projected-stop-risk HHI after 60/40 + integer-share floor

interpretationRule: The exact allocation is allowed to differ between PRE_SHARE and POST_SHARE objectives. If both optima remain materially less concentrated than current, the structural conclusion is robust while the exact comparator allocation is quantization/objective-sensitive.
forbidden: do not use realized outcomes to select objective or allocation
do not call the optimum a recommended live allocator
do not collapse PRE_SHARE and POST_SHARE into one undocumented objective
do not infer economic superiority from structural concentration alone
